name: Ohio Dominican University
academic_ranking: Private Catholic (Dominican) university founded in 1911 in Columbus, OH. Small institution: ~1,139 students enrolled, average class size 15. Offers 30 undergraduate majors and 10 master's degree programs. Reported 91% job and grad-school placement rate within six months of graduation. Incoming class averages (per ODU Fast Facts): 3.4 GPA, 24 ACT, 1021 SAT.
financial_aid: Full-time undergraduate tuition $18,264/semester ($36,528/year) for 2026-2027; tuition & fees total approx. $37,138/year. Cost of attendance living on campus ~$53,950 (in-state). ODU reports 99% of full-time undergraduate students received some form of financial assistance in 2025-2026. Office of Financial Aid: (614) 251-4778, finaid@ohiodominican.edu.
facilities_notes: Home softball venue is Panther Softball Field (on-campus, dedicated softball facilities page on the athletics site). Athletics site: ohiodominicanpanthers.com.
program_reputation: NCAA Division II program competing in the Great Midwest Athletic Conference (G-MAC). Head coach Marcella Vanlandingham leads the Panthers. 2026 roster of 20 players. Team X/Twitter account: @ODU_Softball.
notes: Note on source domain: the athletics URL provided in discovery (odupanthers.com) no longer resolves; the school's current athletics site is ohiodominicanpanthers.com. All data captured live from ohiodominicanpanthers.com (softball coaches and 2026 roster pages) and ohiodominican.edu (Fast Facts, Financial Aid, and 2026-2027 undergraduate tuition & fees pages), checked 2026-07. scholarship_count left null: no publicly listed softball scholarship/equivalency count found on the program pages.
